remarks: Fabulous studio in the heart of vibrant downtown! This well-appointed unit features a modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, spacious living room/bedroom combo that opens to a private balcony with southwest views. Enjoy the convenience of assigned parking, along with access to on-site amenities; including fitness room, laundry room in the basement & courtyard. Heat, h/w & cooking gas included in rent. Prime location close to shops, dining, entertainment & RR.
